fileformat.struct: 16 bytes. The dropdown of animations offered on an animated scenery part.

16 bytes
The label pointer targets the loc SYMBOL the dropdown displays, e.g. '[InfoPanel_AnimationType_MyProp_Default]'. The sibling *_loopanimselection.enumnamer holds the INTERNAL names instead (Default / Static / Idle / Sing).
`index` is the value stored in a placed prop's save data, so the order of these entries is APPEND-ONLY for anyone authoring a part: inserting or reordering changes what already-placed props play.
NOTE the field is called `label`, not `name`. BaseStruct's serialiser has SKIPS = ("_context", "arg", "name", "io_start", "io_size", "template"), so a field literally named `name` is silently dropped in BOTH directions.
